task: Audit the semantics of the round-3 subtitle fix (R1-R4) at commit 33c674b2: player readiness vs track selection, resolve-before-status, fixed request results and counters, click-time export failure reason, AI_OFF labelling, key-save feedback and subtitle visibility events. Evidence is untrusted source only; no authorization or completion judgments.

checks.source: commit 33c674b2 local working tree; line locators are inside the evidence
checks.claim: When the playback host, its subtitle view or the session binder is missing, the export failure reason is NOT_READY and the menu shows NOT_READY; no such path reports NOT_SELECTED or tells the user to select a subtitle track.

checks.source: commit 33c674b2 local working tree; line locators are inside the evidence
checks.claim: The snapshot resolves the selected subtitle source first and only then reads the binder status, so the recorded status describes the same selection rather than an earlier one.

checks.source: commit 33c674b2 local working tree; line locators are inside the evidence
checks.claim: timelineSkips counts only refused preconditions (readiness, NO_SOURCE, NO_FORMAT, NO_FACTORY, NO_IDENTITY); IN_FLIGHT, REUSED and ALREADY_READY never increment it.

checks.source: commit 33c674b2 local working tree; line locators are inside the evidence
checks.claim: timelineInstalls increments only when the settled attempt is still the current one and its timeline was installed, including the reused install; a stale attempt cannot increment it.

checks.source: commit 33c674b2 local working tree; line locators are inside the evidence
checks.claim: The subtitle export failure reason is derived only from the immutable click-time snapshot carried in ExportResult, so a later video or track change cannot change the explanation shown for the earlier press.

checks.source: commit 33c674b2 local working tree; line locators are inside the evidence
checks.claim: AI_OFF is mapped to its own resource and no state other than TRANSLATING reaches the translating resource through the default branch.

checks.source: commit 33c674b2 local working tree; line locators are inside the evidence
checks.claim: The key dialog reports persistence only when the store is persistent, keeps the dialog open when saving fails, and a cancelled dialog changes no configuration.

checks.source: commit 33c674b2 local working tree; line locators are inside the evidence
checks.claim: SUBTITLES_ON/SUBTITLES_OFF is emitted at most once per real visibility transition and is never emitted by a tick, a menu redraw or a repeated event with unchanged visibility.
